mapper.insert: INSERT INTO review (reservation_id, user_id, rating, content) VALUES (#{reservationId}, #{userId}, #{rating}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId}

SELECT r.id, r.reservation_id, r.user_id, r.rating, r.content, r.created_at, u.name AS user_name, s.name AS service_name FROM review r INNER JOIN user_account u ON u.id = r.user_id INNER JOIN reservation rs ON rs.id = r.reservation_id INNER JOIN service_item s ON s.id = rs.service_id ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT 8

SELECT r.id, r.reservation_id, r.user_id, r.rating, r.content, r.created_at, u.name AS user_name, s.name AS service_name FROM review r INNER JOIN user_account u ON u.id = r.user_id INNER JOIN reservation rs ON rs.id = r.reservation_id INNER JOIN service_item s ON s.id = rs.service_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
